name: Glass Slab Logo
description: Turns any logo into a stack of tinted glass discs, ray traced with refraction, reflection, total internal reflection and absorption, and seen from below like a product shot on a lit card. Every horizontal run of the logo becomes one disc; detached pieces get their own finer stack. White and empty parts of the logo are cut out of the glass, so emblems, scripts and line art keep their gaps.
